basic_details.offering_entity: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), Government of Brunei Darussalam
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Universiti Brunei Darussalam (UBD), Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali (UNISSA), Universiti Teknologi Brunei (UTB), and Politeknik Brunei (PB)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to degree programs offered across the 4 institutions: Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics, Petroleum Geosciences, Public Policy, Islamic Studies, Islamic Finance, Health Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 scholarships awarded annually across ASEAN, Commonwealth, and OIC member countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible OIC and Commonwealth member state (~5 to 10 Pakistani students selected annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Diploma (3 years); Bachelor's (4 years); Master's (1 to 2 years)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of ASEAN, Commonwealth, and OIC member countries (Pakistani citizens eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Undergraduate and Diploma: between 18 and 25 years of age; Master's: maximum 35 years of age on July 1 of award year.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years (FSc/A-Levels) for Bachelor's; 16 years (Bachelor's) for Master's from an accredited institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent Second Class Upper / 70%+ marks.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Prerequisites corresponding to chosen degree faculty.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, provided age limits are respected.

english_proficiency.notes: Credit 6 in GCE O-Level English, IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL 75+, or university English proficiency certificate.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English; Arabic required for Islamic Studies programs at UNISSA.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; all eligible candidates welcome.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must be nominated by their home government (Ministry of Foreign Affairs or designated agency in Pakistan).

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition, admission, examination, registration, and orientation fees fully waived.

accommodation.details: Free accommodation at the residential college of the host university or polytechnic.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly personal subsistence allowance paid directly to student.

airfare.details: Economy class return airfare to Brunei Darussalam at the beginning and end of study.

visa_fee.details: Student visa and student pass fees in Brunei Darussalam covered.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical insurance provided throughout the scholarship period.

food_allowance.details: Monthly meals allowance of BND $150/month provided in addition to personal allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Annual book allowance paid directly to scholar.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Baggage allowance for shipping personal effects upon completion (up to BND $500).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Apply for up to two program choices across the 4 participating institutions.
participating_institutions: Universiti Islam Sultan Sharif Ali (UNISSA - Islamic Studies & Law)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: UBD is QS World Rank #387; UTB is World Top 500.
available_majors: Computer Science, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Public Policy, Biomedical Sciences, Islamic Finance, Shariah Law
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Diploma: 3 years; Bachelor's: 4 years; Master's: 1 to 2 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Download official BDGS application form, fill out choices, obtain home government endorsement, and submit via email/portal to MFA Brunei.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Universiti Teknologi Brunei (UTB) and Universiti Brunei Darussalam (UBD) are the premier choices for engineering and sciences.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure Section C of the application form is endorsed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan or the HEC.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Brunei BDGS Online Submission
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Download the official application form from the MFA Brunei website, complete all sections, attach documents, and submit via the specified online portal or email.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Download the official BDGS Application Form from MFA Brunei website (Opens January).
2. Complete the form and choose up to two degree programs from UBD, UTB, UNISSA, or PB.
3. Secure Statement of Purpose and certified academic transcripts.
4. Submit the form to MOFA Pakistan / HEC for official government endorsement (Section C).
5. Email/upload the complete endorsed application to queriesbdgs2024@mfa.gov.bn by deadline (mid-February).
6. Shortlisted applicants may be invited to sit an interview/written test by Brunei selection panel.
7. Award letters issued in June/July; semester commences in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct application via MFA Brunei; admissions are processed centrally.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two referee assessments submitted with the application dossier.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic interests, why you chose Brunei, and how your studies will benefit your home country.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal required for Master's by Research candidates.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Selection committee or host university conducts virtual interview for shortlisted candidates in April/May.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certificates and transcripts must be certified; HEC attestation required.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submitted electronically via email / portal to MFA Brunei.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: BDGS Application Form with Government Endorsement
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official form completed and endorsed by Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) Pakistan
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Section C stamped by MOFA / HEC Islamabad

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts and certificates showing all grades
Personal essay detailing motivation and study plan
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly stating why Brunei is your choice

required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed referee forms on official letterhead
Certified copies of NADRA birth certificate and passport
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Passport must be valid for at least 12 months
Issued by local Pakistani police department

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Application window is strictly January to mid-February each year. Academic year starts in August.

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: MFA Brunei Scholarship Selection Committee in collaboration with university admissions boards.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Assessment of academic merit and strategic country representation among OIC and Commonwealth states.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,000 to 4,000 applications globally across OIC/Commonwealth countries
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Well-rounded students with solid academic records in engineering, business, or Islamic studies.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Students from all provinces of Pakistan seeking quality funded education in a secure, tax-free Islamic country.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Malaysia, Indonesia, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Maldives, Oman.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam emails asking for visa deposits or processing fees for Brunei scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: The Government of Brunei Darussalam scholarship application is 100% FREE.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; apply directly to MFA Brunei.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC / MOFA attestation and courier fees in Pakistan.
Medical checkup expenses prior to departure.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You cannot apply without a government job. (Fact: Open to all private and public students; only government endorsement on Section C is required).
MYTH: Only Islamic studies are taught. (Fact: High-tech Engineering, Petroleum Geoscience, and Computer Science are taught in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some websites state PhD is covered; BDGS officially covers Diploma, Bachelor's, and Master's degrees only.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and pass all examinations in accordance with university rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence and attendance in Brunei Darussalam.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities submit regular progress reports to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are strictly prohibited from engaging in any paid employment during the scholarship tenure.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY Return: Scholars must return to their home country immediately upon completion of their study program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligated to return home; no right to seek employment or permanent stay in Brunei Darussalam.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Expulsion, academic failure, or breach of regulations requires full repayment of scholarship costs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions beyond the standard program period.
